Extract an Analyst Note

Source: R/core-metadata.R
extract_var_note.Rd

Returns the analyst note for a single variable, or NULL if none has been set.

Usage

extract_var_note(x, var)

Arguments

x

A survey design object.

var

<data-masked> Variable name (bare, unquoted).

Value

A character string, or NULL.

See also

set_var_note() to set a note
